The structure of Ba₄Al₄O₈ (reduced formula BaAlO₂) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis shows Al centers in tetrahedral environments with four O neighbors, while Ba centers have seven O neighbors and O centers are three-coordinate, surrounded by two Al and one Ba. The Al tetrahedra share corners, and Al tetrahedra also share corners and edges with Ba coordination polyhedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component containing all 16 sites.
